visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a white product tag held by a hand with a brown leather watch strap. The tag displays Japanese text, a barcode, and the price 6000 yen. The background is a blurry retail environment with clothing racks. (2) A young woman with long dark hair, bangs, and red lipstick appears in a medium shot. She is wearing a blue and white floral camisole. She holds a folded purple and white umbrella pouch in front of her. The setting is indoors with soft, warm lighting. (3) She unfolds the umbrella, extending the telescopic shaft toward the camera. A zoom-in focuses on the purple fabric. She points at the white border of the umbrella with her right hand. The background shows a neutral-toned room with a bed and a glowing headboard lamp. (4) The scene shifts outdoors. A hand holds the folded umbrella against a backdrop of a stone-tiled sidewalk and a city street. Then, the woman is seen from a distance walking away on the sidewalk under a grey, overcast sky. (5) The final phase is a black screen featuring bold red-and-white text centered in the frame.
